title_or_table: Schedule B transfers and refunds to other committees of every joint fundraising committee that paid a 2024 major-party nominee’s campaign, aggregated by recipient
universe_or_base: For each 2024 major-party nominee, every committee the FEC designates a joint fundraising committee (designation J) that paid the nominee’s principal campaign committee in the 2024 cycle, three for Kamala Harris and four for Donald Trump, and every committee each paid on line 22 (transfers) or line 28C (refunds)
vintage: FEC processed filings as the API served them on November 12 and 13, 2026 (the Harris Victory Fund’s and the Trump National Committee JFC’s rows as frozen in fec-jfc-transfers-2024, checked equal on November 13)
qualification: The rule picks the senders: of the 92 committees that paid Harris’s campaign in the cycle, the FEC designates 3 joint fundraising committees, and of the 64 that paid Trump’s, 4; a committee that paid a campaign but is not designated J stays out for both (for example the Donald J. Trump Republican Nominee Fund 2024, an authorized committee). Amounts and transactions are the FEC’s aggregate by recipient for the cycle, which equals, for every row, the itemized payments on one line: line 22, transfers to other committees, or line 28C, a refund of a committee’s own contribution (amount_lines). Line 21B operating expenditures to the same committees are left out of amount and given in line_21b_amount. A joint fundraising committee splits contributions among its participants under its agreement, so a transfer is not a gift from the committee’s own funds. Receivers fold by kind, read the same way for both nominees: the nominee’s principal campaign committee is the nominee campaign; any other committee the FEC lists as a party committee (committee type X or Y) is a national party committee where its statement of organization gives the party type NATIONAL (the DNC and the RNC; no party’s House or Senate committee appears) and a state party committee where it gives STATE (the parties of states, DC and Guam, whatever their names, such as the Oklahoma Leadership Council, the Oklahoma Republican Party’s federal committee); the Missouri Republican State Committee-Federal’s record gives no party type and its own name makes it a state party committee; every other committee (campaigns of other candidates, leadership PACs, other PACs, and the Trump nominee fund) is an other committee. No fund paid another of the seven.

jfc_id.description: FEC committee ID of the joint fundraising committee that paid

jfc_name.description: the joint fundraising committee’s name in the FEC’s committee record

recipient_id.description: FEC ID of the committee paid

recipient_name.description: its name as the FEC’s aggregate by recipient gave it on November 12, 2026: mostly the committee’s name today, but Harris’s campaign under its 2024 name and Trump’s under its name today; print recipient_name_2024_election

recipient_type.description: committee type as the FEC lists it today; both campaign committees have since become PACs, and is_nominee_campaign marks them

schedule_b_lines.description: every Schedule B line the itemized payments to this committee use, line 21B included; amount sums only the line in amount_lines

is_nominee_campaign.description: yes for the nominee’s principal campaign committee

recipient_name_2024_election.description: the name the joint fundraising committee wrote for this recipient on its last itemized payment dated on or before November 5, 2024 (its first payment, where none came before), read the same way for every recipient

recipient_names_itemized.description: every name the itemized payments give this recipient, each with its row count and first and last date

amount_lines.description: the Schedule B line amount and transactions sum: 22, transfers to other committees, or 28C, a refund of a committee’s contribution

line_21b_amount.description: line 21B operating expenditures paid to the same committee in the cycle, not in amount

line_21b_transactions.description: itemized line 21B payments, not in transactions

recipient_designation.description: the recipient committee’s designation in the FEC’s committee record today (for example principal campaign committee, leadership PAC, unauthorized)

recipient_party_type.description: for a party committee, the party type its statement of organization (Form 1) gives in the FEC’s committee record: NATIONAL or STATE; empty for any other committee, and for one party committee whose record gives none

recipient_kind.description: the receiver’s kind by the rule in the qualification: nominee campaign, national party committee, state party committee or other committee

printed_source_line: Source: Federal Election Commission, Schedule B transfers and refunds to other committees (lines 22 and 28C) of the seven committees the FEC designates joint fundraising committees that paid Kamala Harris’s or Donald Trump’s campaign, 2023 to 2024 cycle, United States. Retrieved November 12 and 13, 2026. Committees named as their payer wrote them before the November 5, 2024 election.
